artworks.title: Distant View of Mount Akiha, Kakegawa
artworks.dimensions: image: 22.54 × 34.93 cm (8 7/8 × 13 3/4 in.) (approximate dimensions; sealed inside mat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: This print shows a curved bridge extending from the bottom right toward the center. The horizon line shows a foggy landscape in the distance beyond a body of water, with mountains on the right side. The sky transitions from deep blue at the top to a lighter beige near the horizon. People in wide hats and long robes are crossing the bridge, including a child in a pink garment. There are streetlamps or birdhouses extending up in front of the bridge. Beyond the bridge is a body of blue water with swaying reeds. The color palette consists of soft blues, earthy browns, and gentle greys.

artworks.title: Cover for the Album "Paysages et intérieurs"
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in green and two shades of gray on China paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with furniture and a seated figure. The image depicts an intimate interior with a blend of abstract and representational elements. Dominated by earthy and muted tones of green and brown, the scene features a cluttered setting that includes a table, a chair, and some abstract forms that resemble a figure reading. The composition shows fluid, loose brushwork and layered text, suggesting an artistic poster or print style. This style is reminiscent of Édouard Vuillard, known for his involvement in the Nabi movement and his emphasis on intimate domestic interiors.

artworks.title: Nadie se conoce (Nobody Knows Himself)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: This drawing shows masked figures in elaborate costumes. It depicts a gathering where figures in ornate attire interact, each wearing masks. The background is dark, highlighting the central characters. The figures wear flowing garments with rich textures, and their masks add mystery and intrigue. The drawing conveys the elegance and enigma of a masked event, using intricate lines and shading for detail and emotion.

artworks.title: Gentleman with Hand in Vest
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 12.2 × 7.8 cm (4 13/16 × 3 1/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, turned slightly to the left with their head turned slightly to the right. They have long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, a slender face, and are wearing detailed, period clothing including a long coat, vest, knee-length breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. The person is not wearing any visible jewelry, but there is a partial view of a pocket watch chain. In the background, there are artistic renditions of trees on the left and a distant building or architectural structure against a backdrop of clouds on the right.

artworks.title: Cupid and Psyche
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One figure is reclining on a bed, appearing asleep, with a full view of their face and blue wings attached to their back. The other figure is standing beside the bed, holding an oil lamp in one hand and a dagger in the other. The standing figure has long hair and is draped in a light cloth. The bed is covered with white and light blue drapery. In the foreground, there is an ornate gold vessel with rising smoke, suggesting an incense burner. The background features heavy drapery.

artworks.title: The Wire #4
artworks.creditLine: Scott Nathan and Laura DeBonis Fund
artworks.description: The image shows multiple large rolls of wire mesh in a uniform pattern. The color palette is sepia tones, giving it a vintage appearance. The rolls are arranged in rows, extending from the bottom left to the top right of the image, with each subsequent row slightly elevating in the background.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Title Page]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a central circular emblem with the text "GLORIA TIBI," surrounded by smaller symbols, and two large creatures resembling monkeys positioned symmetrically on either side of this emblem. There are elaborate botanical elements including leaves, flowers, and various fruits like pumpkins and grapes adjacent to the monkeys. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Part 1, Plate 1, from the series Archetypa studiaque (Archetypes and Studies)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This print features a large beetle in the center, accompanied by a butterfly, a caterpillar, a fly, and some other small bugs. Around these creatures, there are a branching plant with flowers, a rose, half a pear, and a spiral shell. At the top and bottom of the print are some lines of text.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 2]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: A large snail shell with a butterfly on it is centered in the image. Surrounding them are various insects and plants, including grasshoppers, locusts, and a dragonfly. The image is in monochrome tones of beige and black. Detailed drawings of leaves and flowers are on either side, with a peach and an open walnut at the bottom, and a large flower head and a hop cone nearby.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 3]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows an array of detailed illustrations including a mouse, a butterfly, a rose, a snail, and a lily as the largest objects. The color palette consists of shades of black and gray in an engraving style. Positioned centrally is the mouse surrounded by a butterfly and dragonfly above it, a rose to the left, and a lily to the right. At the bottom, various small insects and plant parts, such as pods and seeds, are arranged, along with text both at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 4]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows multiple insects and flowers. In the center, there is a large grasshopper with a butterfly to the right and a dragonfly above it. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of tan and brown. On the left, there is a large lily with a snail and a butterfly, and on the right, other flowers and an insect resembling a mosquito. At the bottom, there are more flowers and fruits, with Latin text near the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 5]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features various elements such as an upside-down bell-shaped flower surrounded by an insect in the upper center, a moth hovering near a flower on the left, a long insect near a curling flower on the right, and a fruit with a snail crawling towards it and a small fly on its surface in the lower center. The color palette consists of monochrome shades with varying intensities of black, brown, and grey on a light background. Various smaller plants, leaves, and berries are scattered throughout the artwork, creating a detailed and intricate composition.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 6]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows various insects and plants arranged around a central beetle. The elements include a butterfly, flower, pomegranate, grasshopper, conch shell, cherries, and additional flowers. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of brownish-black and off-white.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 7]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The objects in the image are an apple, a frog, and a snail. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring intricate lines and shading in shades of gray. The apple is in the lower left corner, the frog is positioned slightly above the center right, and the snail is near the bottom center. Other elements in the scene include a butterfly near the top right, a moth in the upper center, and a dragonfly near the center right. Various plants, insects, and small creatures are also depicted.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 8]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed moth in the center, with two lilies on either side. The artwork is monochromatic with shades of brown and black on a light background. Below the moth is a round fruit similar to a peach with a dragonfly perched on it. At the bottom left, there is a spider near a beetle, and on the right side, several bugs are arranged, including a caterpillar and a snail on a pea pod. All elements are evenly spaced across the image, creating a balanced composition.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 9]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays a large lemon, a plum, and cherries in detail alongside leaves. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white. At the top, there are flowers, insects, and a caterpillar in a horizontal line. Below them is a long slug. Towards the bottom, a bee is near the lemon on the left, and an insect resembling a spider is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 10]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed mouse in the center, a dragonfly to the right, and a large butterfly at the top-center. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. Additionally, there are berries with leaves on the left, a pear on the bottom right, a grasshopper on the bottom left, and a snake near a plant at the bottom. Various insects, such as a moth and smaller bugs, are scattered around the composition.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 11]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The largest objects in the image are a lizard in the upper center and an apple-like fruit with a butterfly perched on it, positioned to the left. The color palette is monochrome, comprised of black and white, resembling a classic ink illustration. The lizard is situated slightly to the right of center, with its head pointing towards the right, while the apple-like fruit with the butterfly is located towards the lower left. Below the lizard, there is a large leaf with a cucumber-like object, and to the right, next to the leaves, are various seed pods and flowers. Other insects, including a dragonfly, bee, spider, and beetle, are dispersed throughout the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 12]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a variety of objects, including a butterfly, a grasshopper, and a dragonfly. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. The butterfly is in the upper right corner, the grasshopper is below and to the left, and the dragonfly is above the grasshopper. Other objects in the image include a snail, seed pods, pieces of fruit, a small fly near the snail, a ladybug in the bottom right corner, and a caterpillar in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 2, Title Page]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays a large ornate vase filled with an arrangement of flowers and foliage at the center. Perched on each side of the vase are birds. The left side features an assortment of fruits and vegetables like grapes and a melon, while the right side mirrors this with apples and pears. The color palette is monochrome using shades of sepia and brown. A fish and a rabbit hang from the top corners, tapering down towards the central vase.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 2, Plate 1]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features an intricately detailed beetle with large mandibles in the upper center. Surrounding the beetle are other objects, including an insect resembling a dragonfly to the left, a curled caterpillar on a plant stem at the top right, and a flower in full bloom to the left. Two fruits, one resembling a pear at the bottom left and another possibly a peach at the bottom right, complete the composition. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily composed of varying shades of sepia and black. The beetle is centrally positioned, dominating the arrangement, with the dragonfly and flower to its immediate left, the caterpillar above it to the right, and the fruits at the bottom framing the scene.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 2, Plate 2]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays a large, intricate drawing of a blooming flower at the top center, surrounded by various insects and plant forms, such as a snail, a mantis, and other insects scattered around. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and white. The snail is placed towards the upper right side of the image, partially on a stem, while a large mantis is depicted beneath it closer to the foreground. A shell-like structure is located on the right side of the flower, with smaller insects distributed across the lower section, including worms, a fly, and a beetle. Floral elements are visible on the left and right edges, framing the composition.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 2, Plate 3]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: There is a dragonfly at the top center of the image and two large fruits towards the bottom left. The color palette consists of black, shades of gray, and beige. From the top left, there is a spider on its web, followed by foliage, flowers, other insects, and a dragonfly. Moving right, there is a blooming flower and a pea pod. Below, a beetle and a winged insect are near the large fruits. Further down, there is a cluster of grapes on the right, with a centipede under leafy greenery. Various smaller insects and vegetative elements are spread throughout the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 2, Plate 4]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The tarantula is hanging upside down near the center, a large bulb is in the lower center surrounded by plant roots and a butterfly, and a large flower is on the left. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray. The tarantula is near the center of the image, the bulb is directly below it with the butterfly to the left of the bulb, and the large flower is in the top left quadrant. A plant with a long stem and large leaves is on the right with a snail and acorns near the bottom on the right. A bee is seen to the left of the tarantula, and a smaller spider is located at the bottom left.
